items.content:
## Rules
- Added: the mobile app shows an order's status only after payment is confirmed (from the plan gate).

## Lessons
- All repositories: name the child repository in the Jira issue (the plan gate sent the plan back once).
- orders-api: its tests need Docker on the runner (the story halted once in implementation).

## Left out
Nothing.
